trans-unit.source: 陆行鸟鞍囊登录后自动请求。收藏柜在当前地图直接请求物品数据，无需打开界面。投影台通过原界面获取数据，当前场景不可用时尝试进入旅馆；界面打开后约 10 秒仍未加载数据则结束操作，保留原物品缓存。 传唤铃会在 100 米范围内使用一键打开雇员铃，超出范围时尝试进入旅馆。部队箱打开后直接请求各页，无需逐页切换；自动前往部队箱需要 vnavmesh（推荐使用 CN 版）。 每次获取仅记录当前登录角色；角色统计范围会影响物品悬浮窗和物品查询中显示的个人物品来源。

Glamour dresser data is obtained through its original interface; if unavailable in the current area, an inn room is attempted. If data is still unavailable about 10 seconds after the interface opens, stop and retain the previous item cache. Summoning bells use quick interaction within 100 m; otherwise an inn room is attempted. Company chest pages are requested directly after opening, without switching through each page. Automatically traveling to the company chest requires vnavmesh, preferably the CN version. Each retrieval records only the currently logged-in character. Character scope affects personal item sources shown in tooltips and Item Lookup.

trans-unit.target: Item Price Lookup: display market prices and request listings. Item Lookup: display owned quantities, storage locations, and related information. Item Previews: add item information, images, and target appearance previews. Remote Market Board: open the market board and buy in permitted areas. Remote NPC Shop: navigate to NPC shops and complete purchases. Remote Glamour Dresser / Armoire: use the armoire and open glamour dressers in inn rooms.
